verdict.rationale: gstack is a skills and tooling pack that runs inside AI coding agent hosts such as Claude Code, Codex and Cursor, rather than an agent itself. Publishing an official MCP server is therefore a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents skills, host config files, a browser CLI ($B) and an agents digest, but never mentions an MCP server or MCP endpoint.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
